# Novaleo Weight & Wellness

> Novaleo Weight & Wellness is a telehealth functional medicine practice in Grand Rapids, Michigan, serving women in Michigan and Wisconsin. Founded by Kathryn Long, NP-C, a board-certified nurse practitioner with 20+ years of healthcare experience, Novaleo specializes in root-cause treatment for fatigue, brain fog, hormone imbalance, weight resistance, and metabolic dysfunction in professional women in their 40s and 50s.

## Services
- [Root Cause Discovery Call](https://novaweightandwellness.com/scheduler): Free 10-minute consultation to determine next steps.
- [Root Cause Intake — 60-Minute Clarity Session](https://novaweightandwellness.com/scheduler): $97 comprehensive clinical assessment.
- [Root Cause Lab Panel](https://novaweightandwellness.com/scheduler): $454 signature biomarker panel including full thyroid, nutrients, inflammation, metabolic markers.
- [The Executive Longevity Partnership](https://novaweightandwellness.com/services): $3,995 six-month executive-level program limited to 4 clients.
- [Root Cause Follow-up](https://novaweightandwellness.com/scheduler): 30–60 min follow-up for enrolled clients.

## Conditions Treated
- [Conditions We Treat](https://novaweightandwellness.com/conditions): Persistent fatigue, brain fog, weight resistance, perimenopause & menopause, thyroid dysfunction, hormone imbalance, metabolic & insulin resistance, gut & digestive issues, sleep disruption, stress & burnout, autoimmune support, inflammation.

## About the Provider
- [About Kathryn Long, NP-C](https://novaweightandwellness.com/about): Board-certified nurse practitioner, certified in medical weight management, 20+ years in healthcare, specializing in hormones and metabolic health for women in midlife.

## How It Works
- [Our Approach](https://novaweightandwellness.com/approach): 4-step process — choose your starting point, root-cause review, personalized plan, guided support.
